display.purpose: Regular EB Garamond welcome and large introductions.

display-accent.purpose: Same-size italic EB Garamond emphasis within display headings.

headline.purpose: EB Garamond workspace page headings with local compact variants.

title.purpose: Compact Figtree ledger and rail headings.

body.purpose: Figtree operational text, forms, and reading.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ordinary ink action with a pill silhouette.
components.css: .ds-primary { font-family:Figtree,sans-serif; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:40px; padding:10px 19px; background:var(--text, #1a1a1a); color:var(--bg, #ffffeb); border:1px solid var(--text, #1a1a1a); border-radius:999px; font-size:13px; font-weight:500; cursor:pointer; transition:background 180ms; } .ds-primary:hover { background:#393932; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus, #80509a); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-primary:disabled { opacity:.5; cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Lavender Upload Button
components.description: Outlined lavender action for the welcome.
components.css: .ds-lavender { font-family:Figtree,sans-serif; min-height:44px; padding:10px 20px; background:var(--lavender, #f0d7ff); color:var(--text, #1a1a1a); border:1.5px solid var(--text, #1a1a1a); border-radius:8px; font-size:13px; font-weight:500; cursor:pointer; transition:background 180ms; } .ds-lavender:hover { background:#e6c6f8; } .ds-lavender:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus, #80509a); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-ghost { font-family:Figtree,sans-serif; min-height:38px; padding:9px 14px; background:transparent; color:var(--text, #1a1a1a); border:1px solid #b7b7a7; border-radius:999px; font-size:12px; cursor:pointer; transition:background 180ms; } .ds-ghost:hover { background:#eeeee1; } .ds-ghost:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus, #80509a); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Workspace Field
components.description: Labeled inset field with clear focus.
components.html: <label class="ds-label" for="ds-workspace">Workspace name</label><input class="ds-input" id="ds-workspace" placeholder="Your workspace">
components.css: .ds-label { font-family:Figtree,sans-serif; display:block; margin-bottom:6px; color:var(--text, #1a1a1a); font-size:12px; } .ds-input { font-family:Figtree,sans-serif; max-width:100%; padding:8px 10px; background:var(--panel-2, #f0f0e2); color:var(--text, #1a1a1a); border:1px solid var(--border, #deded0); border-radius:6px; font-size:14px; line-height:1.55; caret-color:var(--accent, #1a1a1a); transition:border-color 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:var(--muted, #62625a); } .ds-input:hover,.ds-input:focus { border-color:#62625a; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus, #80509a); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Active Navigation
components.css: .ds-nav { background:var(--forest, #1a1a1a); padding:18px; } .ds-nav-active { font-family:Figtree,sans-serif; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; width:100%; min-height:44px; padding:12px; border:0; border-radius:8px; background:var(--lavender, #f0d7ff); color:var(--text, #1a1a1a); font-size:13px; font-weight:750; text-align:left; cursor:pointer; transition:background 180ms; } .ds-nav-active svg { width:17px; height:17px; } .ds-active-dot { width:5px; height:5px; border-radius:50%; margin-left:auto; background:var(--text, #1a1a1a); } .ds-nav-active:hover { background:var(--lavender, #f0d7ff); } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus, #80509a); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Completed Status
components.description: Explicit completion text with quiet cream treatment.
components.css: .ds-status { font-family:Figtree,sans-serif; display:inline-block; padding:4px 7px; border-radius:5px; background:var(--bg, #ffffeb); color:var(--muted, #62625a); font-size:12px; }

components.name: Meeting Ledger
components.description: Flat paper work container with inset cream footer.
components.html:
Recent meetings

Your workspace meetings
Extension captures & uploads, together
components.css: .ds-ledger { font-family:Figtree,sans-serif; overflow:hidden; padding:22px 24px 0; border:1px solid var(--border, #deded0); border-radius:14px; color:var(--text, #1a1a1a); background:var(--panel, #fffef6); } .ds-ledger-title { font-size:14px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-.02em; margin:0 0 18px; } .ds-ledger-row { padding:20px 0; border-top:1px solid var(--border, #deded0); font-size:12px; } .ds-ledger-footer { margin:0 -24px; padding:14px 24px; color:var(--muted, #62625a); background:#f4f4e8; font-size:12px; }

components.name: Capture Strip
components.description: Compact ink strip with a cream 27-bar waveform and finite motion.
components.html:
Be there. We’ll take it from here.

Live audio. Clear notes. Every next step, captured.
components.css: .ds-capture { font-family:Figtree,sans-serif; display:flex; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:22px; padding:17px 22px; background:var(--text, #1a1a1a); color:var(--bg, #ffffeb); border-radius:14px; overflow:hidden; } .ds-visual { display:grid; place-items:center; flex:0 0 152px; min-height:50px; border:1px solid #74746a; border-radius:999px; background:var(--bg, #ffffeb); color:var(--text, #1a1a1a); } .ds-signal { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:3px; height:48px; padding:0 14px; overflow:hidden; } .ds-signal i { display:block; width:2px; flex-shrink:0; border-radius:2px; background:currentColor; transform-origin:center; animation:ds-settle 1400ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) 3; } .ds-signal i:nth-child(3n) { animation-delay:150ms; } .ds-capture-copy { flex:1; min-width:180px; } .ds-capture h3 { margin:0 0 3px; font-size:16px; font-weight:500; line-height:1.4; letter-spacing:-.015em; } .ds-capture p { color:#c6c6b9; font-size:12px; margin:0; line-height:1.6; } .ds-capture-button { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; border:1px solid #6a6a60; background:transparent; color:var(--bg, #ffffeb); padding:10px 14px; min-height:40px; border-radius:999px; font-family:Figtree,sans-serif; font-size:12px; cursor:pointer; transition:background 180ms,color 180ms; } .ds-capture-button svg { width:16px; height:16px; } .ds-capture-button:hover { background:var(--lavender, #f0d7ff); color:var(--text, #1a1a1a); border-color:var(--lavender, #f0d7ff); } .ds-capture-button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus, #80509a); outline-offset:4px; } @keyframes ds-settle { 0%,100% { transform:scaleY(.85); } 50% { transform:scaleY(.4); } } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-signal i { animation:none; } }

narrative.overview: The user confirmed a restyle of the existing app. Cream, charcoal, lavender, and editorial EB Garamond headings replace the earlier forest/citrus system. Figtree keeps operational content compact and readable. Flat paper surfaces and fine dividers support dense meeting and task records.
keyCharacteristics: Cream canvas, charcoal navigation, and lavender selection.
Regular and italic serif display with Figtree controls and data.
Flat ledgers, visible focus, and finite 27-bar waveform motion.

rules.name: The Compatibility Rule
rules.body: Forest and citrus remain code aliases for charcoal and lavender; they do not restore the former palette.

rules.name: The Reading Rule
rules.body: Keep serif expression in headings and metric values; keep operational detail in Figtree.

dos: Do use the cream, ink, and lavender system across app surfaces.
Do preserve keyboard focus, readable states, labeled controls, and reduced motion.
Do design loading, empty, offline, and labeled examples with the same care as populated views.
donts: Don’t restore the superseded forest/citrus palette through alias names.
Don’t style dense data, navigation, or form labels in serif.
Don’t present example records as live data or imply unavailable checkout and contact actions work.
